title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 10.5 Tessellations: Apply translations, rotations, and reflections.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 10.5 Tessellations: Apply translations, rotations, and reflections.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "10.5 Tessellations", prints these objectives: "Apply translations, rotations, and reflections." "Determine if a shape tessellates.". The section text says: "A regular tessellation means that the pattern is made up of congruent regular polygons, same size and shape, including some type of movement ; that is, some type of transformation or symmetry. Here we consider the rigid motions of translations, rotations, reflections, or glide reflections. A plane of tessellations has the following properties:" This card reports that page.
